about_the_game:
Adds recipes for combat items, accessories, and Simple Synthesis, as well as blueprints for the Building feature.

Note:
- Recipes can be checked after unlocking Simple Synthesis and placing a Recipe Recall Station, and blueprints can be checked after unlocking base building.
- This product is part of the "Atelier Yumia Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.
